description: This is a configuration file for ESLint setup in a Vue.js project using TypeScript. It imports various plugins and configurations, and exports a default configuration using 'defineConfigWithVueTs'. It specifies file patterns for linting and ignoring certain directories, and integrates plugins such as vue, vitest, and prettier.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: Defines and exports the ESLint configuration with Vue TypeScript integrations.
